applicationFee.note: Central FAQ explicitly limits waivers to domestic military/veteran, McNair, Fulbright Student Scholar and current full-time USM employee categories. No general international waiver.

english.note: IELTS Academic; PTE 54 or iTEP Academic 4 also accepted. Citizens or degree holders from listed countries exempt; foreign MOI letters not accepted. Graduate program may require higher scores; none established on opened Biology landing page.

documents: Official transcripts and degree certificates/diplomas from prior institutions
Letter of interest and resume recommended if seeking assistantship
Three-year non-EU degree: extra year coursework or NACES full bachelor’s equivalency evaluation
requirements.note: Undergraduate biological-sciences major or equivalent. Direct bachelor’s-to-PhD possible with advisor/committee/chair approval. Central minimum last 60 undergraduate GPA 2.75 without master’s; with master’s, graduate GPA 3.5. Faculty selects students for own research group; without willing advisor admission/funding unlikely. GRE not established for new PhD applications; handbook requests it specifically for internal MS-to-PhD change, which is not treated as a universal new-applicant rule.

funding.note: Competitive TA/RA positions include tuition waiver/health insurance. Program publishes undated PhD academic-year TA stipend $12, 000 and expected summer support bringing annual total to$16, 000; confirm current rates. Central international page says assistantships cover tuition/nonresident fees, but stipend often insufficient for living/I-20 expenses; external funds may be necessary. No guarantee.
